Coordinator review of api/client-perf.md: **approved**, with the corrections you made to the audit accepted (TS HarnessClient and terminal.rs already gone; reuse the existing registry and defaults). One addition.

**Status for unfollowed agents.** A tree node shows each child's status (running, idle, waiting, done) without following it. Reading one last record per child would cost N round trips per page. Instead, ask Streams for `children_page` with an option that returns, for each child, the **tail record of a named relative stream** (e.g. `status`), in the same page response, bounded by page bytes. That is a Streams A3 API change. Its owner is now Cloud's **rx-hostability** (the topology moved; see  once it exists). Write the request to `<UTC>.md` and send it through the coordinator, since this is a cross-org request. Build against it behind the trait with a memory-provider implementation meanwhile.

Note: PR #1508 is still in the gate. Start the A7 PR from main once #1508 merges; until then, prepare on a branch. Keep each Linux job under 10 min with affected-crate scope.
